thread:
sam: FYI customer: acme-corp escalated — multiple 401s and sudden token-auth failures + spikes in latency this morning. They included a request id and a snippet, asking for repro help.
leo: Can you paste the exact request-id(s) and the curl they used? Need model, region, and exact timestamp to find traces.
sam: Request IDs: req_0b9fa3c2, req_0b9fa3d7. Timestamps ~ 2026-03-15T10:12:03Z and 10:12:17Z. Model: redwood-v2-s. Region: us-west-2. Customer says they hit 401 then 504 on retry.
sam: Customer curl (redacted credential):
```
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED_API_KEY>" \ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  -d '{"model":"redwood-v2-s","input":"<USER_PROMPT>","max_tokens":512}'
```
cheng: Thanks — can you also attach the server-side trace IDs? I can search logs if we have the x-request-id header from our proxy. Did they include any response bodies? sam: They included this response body for req_0b9fa3c2:
```
{"error":{"type":"auth_error","message":"Invalid API key: key_123456"}}
```
leo: That looks like an invalid key for the first one. For the 504s, need the full proxy trace. ops-oncall: I pulled traces for the timestamps you gave; the edge returned 401 then upstream timeout at 10:12:17. Evidence points to a transient downstream overload on alloc-group-5, but we need a reproducible curl that both reproduces latency and does not leak PII.
marie: Important: before we share any prompt content internally or with SRE, we must scrub PII. Customer prompt includes full customer names and emails — we need a pseudonymized prompt and a separate scrubbing checklist.
privacy-bot: Policy reminder: replace any of the following with tokens: emails -> <EMAIL_REDACTED>, phone numbers -> <PHONE_REDACTED>, full names -> <NAME_REDACTED>, national ids -> <ID_REDACTED>. If you need context for debugging, provide a 2-3 sentence pseudonymized snippet and the original prompt hashed with SHA256 for correlation (do NOT attach original plaintext).
sam: Understood. I'm asking the customer to provide a scrubbed prompt and also to run a minimal repro curl with masked key. I'll ask them to replace names/emails with placeholders. Suggested message to customer:
"Can you resend a minimal repro: (1) a curl with Authorization set to 'Bearer <REDACTED>', (2) the exact model + region, (3) the prompt with all PII replaced (e.g., <EMAIL_REDACTED>, <NAME_REDACTED>), and (4) permission to generate a debug bundle that will be scrubbed before we view it?"
leo: Once we have that, here's the minimal repro curl we prefer (customer should not paste real key):
```
curl -v -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>" \ 
  -H "X-Region: us-west-2" \ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  -d '{"model":"redwood-v2-s","input":"Please summarize customer ticket: <REDACTED_PROMPT>","max_tokens":256}'
```
cheng: For the debug bundle, ask them to run our helper which automatically scrubs API keys and PII before upload:
```
rb-debug collect --request-id req_0b9fa3c2 --since "2026-03-15T09:50:00Z" --scrub --upload
```
ops-oncall: If they can't run the helper, we can take a manual bundle. But we need these items from them:
- curl reproduction (with placeholders)
- request id(s)
- region + model
- masked prompt (3-5 lines around the failing area)
- permission to receive debug bundle (we'll scrub on our side too)
marie: When providing the prompt snippet, instruct the customer to keep at most 200 characters and to replace any names/emails with <NAME_REDACTED>/<EMAIL_REDACTED>. Also ask them to provide a SHA256 of the original prompt if they can (we'll only use this for correlation). Example pseudonymized snippet: "Please remove John Doe (<EMAIL_REDACTED>) from the mailing list and summarize last 3 messages."
sam: I'll message the customer now with those exact steps. I'll also request that they whitelist our debug-bundle upload domain so the upload doesn't get blocked.
leo: Once we get the scrubbed bundle and repro curl, I'll run a tiled repro against alloc-group-5 and post traces. If it's an auth rotation issue, we'll check our key ingestion logs and KMS rotation events.
privacy-bot: When staff upload debug bundles to internal S3, ensure the s3 path is lifecycle-limited and access is only to triage team. Use redwood-priv/scrubbed-debug/ for uploads.
ops-oncall: Added note: if the customer sees 401 only on retries, check edge token propagation and any custom proxy rewrites on their side. Ask them to include any intermediate proxy headers.
sam: Customer replied: "I ran the helper and uploaded the scrubbed bundle. Repro curl posted with placeholders. SHA256: 9b1c2f3e..." I'll attach the link once they confirm.
leo: Great — once link is here I'll pull the bundle, run local repro, and escalate to infra if we see repeated timeouts. :white_check_mark:
marie: Thanks all — keeping PII out of triage is critical. If legal needs an unredacted copy for a compliance request, we will route through lawful-request and get explicit consent.
sam: Closing loop with customer now. Will update thread with bundle link and final status."
